code_hints: After navigation, attempt to click the cookie consent: await clickIfVisible('#onetrust-accept-btn-handler', 3000).
If current URL is the homepage ('/en-de/' root) and no product grid appears within 5s, force-navigate to the PLP start_url override.
Wait for and validate PLP by ensuring at least one tile under [data-testid='product-grid'] or [class*='product-grid'] before extraction.
Implement a simple loader: scroll to bottom and click a 'Load more' if present (e.g., button[data-testid='load-more']) until it disappears or max iterations reached.
Set Accept-Language header to en-DE to reduce locale modals; also rely on URL normalization to keep locale pinned to /en-de/.

Extract PDP links from product tiles by targeting anchor tags within the grid; if site selectors exist, use them first, else fallback to grid a[href*='/en-de/'] with a href length threshold to avoid nav links.
On PDP, wait for price via [itemprop='price'], [data-testid='pdp-price'], or meta[itemprop='price'] content as fallbacks; title via h1 or [data-testid='pdp-title'].
rationale: Crawler landed on the Moncler homepage (/en-de/) where no PLP tiles exist, likely due to locale/cookie gating. The safest minimal change is to start directly on a stable category PLP and accept the common OneTrust cookie banner. Pinning the locale to /en-de/ via URL normalization prevents geolocation redirects (e.g., to /en-jp) and avoids accidental hops to monclergroup.com. We keep selector changes minimal and rely on the existing product selectors once the PLP reliably materializes.
